description: Source code for the xdiff library implementing file differencing algorithms, including Myers' algorithm, with functions for computing diffs, managing change groups, and scoring split positions.

classes.name: xdpsplit_t
classes.description: Structure representing a split point in the Myers' difference algorithm.

classes.name: xdlgroup
classes.description: Structure representing a group of changed lines in a file for diff processing.

methods.name: xdl_split
methods.description: Performs the Myers' difference algorithm's split step to find the furthest reach point.

methods.name: xdl_recs_cmp
methods.description: Recursively compares record ranges between two files to identify differences.

methods.name: xdl_do_diff
methods.description: Main function to perform diff computation between two memory-mapped files.

methods.name: xdl_add_change
methods.description: Creates a new change record and links it into the change list.

methods.name: recs_match
methods.description: Checks if two records have the same minimal perfect hash.

methods.name: get_indent
methods.description: Calculates indentation level of a line, treating tabs as 8 spaces.

methods.name: measure_split
methods.description: Measures characteristics of a hypothetical split position in a file.

methods.name: score_add_split
methods.description: Calculates a heuristic score for a potential split position based on indentation and blank lines.

methods.name: score_cmp
methods.description: Compares two split scores to determine which is better.

methods.name: xdl_build_script
methods.description: Builds an edit script from the diff data.

methods.name: xdl_change_compact
methods.description: Optimizes change groups by sliding them to produce a more intuitive diff.

methods.name: xdl_free_script
methods.description: Frees the linked list of change records.

methods.name: xdl_call_hunk_func
methods.description: Calls a user-defined function for each diff hunk.

methods.name: xdl_mark_ignorable_lines
methods.description: Marks lines as ignorable based on blank line heuristics.

methods.name: record_matches_regex
methods.description: Checks if a record matches any ignore regex.

methods.name: xdl_mark_ignorable_regex
methods.description: Marks lines as ignorable based on regex patterns.

methods.name: xdl_diff
methods.description: High-level function to compute and output the diff between two files, managing environment setup, diff calculation, and output formatting.
